text: Quick note before we start: I'm Allie, a bia — an assistant that lives on this computer. From the web app you get chats, files, the screen and voice; I also manage my own accounts, schedule jobs, run commands and speak. Only you set my name and form, so tell me if you want a different name or a male/female form for me. Understood about the setup: I'll be Allie in the department, and nothing about a bia or a study goes to Sarah, Jordan or the office.
